title: Waitangi Treaty Grounds Review
meta_desc: Discover if Waitangi Treaty Grounds is suitable for your family, with free entry for under-15s, world-class museum, and stunning Bay of Islands views from $40/adult.
intro: The Waitangi Treaty Grounds is a significant historical site in New Zealand, but is it suitable for families? We visited with kids to find out. With free entry for under-15s and a world-class museum, it's an attractive option for families. But what's it really like with kids?

sections.heading: What to Expect
sections.body:
Waitangi Treaty Grounds is a must-visit for anyone interested in New Zealand's history. The grounds are beautifully maintained and offer stunning views of the Bay of Islands. The museum is world-class, with interactive exhibits that bring the history to life. However, with a minimum age suitability of 5+, it may not be suitable for very young children.

The daily Maori cultural performance is a highlight, but be aware that it may not be engaging for very young children. The performance is about an hour long, and while it's a great way to learn about Maori culture, it may be challenging for kids under 7 to sit through.
list: Stunning views of the Bay of Islands

sections.heading: Value for Money
sections.body:
With free entry for under-15s, Waitangi Treaty Grounds is a great value option for families. Adults cost $40 each, which is reasonable considering the quality of the museum and the cultural performance. However, if you're traveling with very young children, you may not get the full value out of the experience.

It's worth noting that the grounds and museum can be explored at your own pace, so you can take breaks and come back to the exhibits if your kids get restless. This makes it a relatively relaxed and stress-free experience for families.

sections.heading: Insider Tips and Best Time to Visit
sections.body:
To get the most out of your visit, plan to arrive in the morning or early afternoon. This will give you time to explore the grounds and museum before the cultural performance. It's also a good idea to check the weather forecast and plan your visit for a sunny day, as the views of the Bay of Islands are a major part of the experience.

If you're looking to save money, consider visiting during the off-season or booking a family pass. You can book tickets online in advance to avoid waiting in line.
list: Arrive in the morning or early afternoon

sections.heading: Downsides for Families
sections.body:
While Waitangi Treaty Grounds is a great option for families, there are some downsides to consider. The minimum age suitability of 5+ means that it may not be suitable for very young children. Additionally, the cultural performance may not be engaging for kids under 7, and the exhibits can be quite dense and text-heavy.

However, overall, Waitangi Treaty Grounds is a great option for families with older children who are interested in history and culture. With its stunning views, world-class museum, and daily cultural performance, it's a must-visit destination in the Bay of Islands.
